task_intent: Refine five Tessera games with expressive native boards and matching wall compositions.

references.observed: An expansive readiness arc frames a large score; the status and supporting explanation have a clear hierarchy.
references.applied: A 41-tick proximity dial frames the current semantic rank, with a separate word and compact best-rank footer. The same geometry is drawn natively and on the wall.

references.observed: Contributor rows pair concise labels and right-aligned values with restrained horizontal measure bars.
references.applied: The guess trail pairs words and ranks with logarithmic proximity bars. Closest/recent ordering and incremental inline expansion keep the main gameplay controls reachable.

references.observed: The official game presents finding a secret word as its central objective. Its full game requires JavaScript.
references.applied: The native flow foregrounds the secret-word objective; guesses, repeated guesses, winning and voluntary reveal have distinct acknowledged states.

references.observed: Word vectors model semantic relations through co-occurrence; vector similarity supports nearest-neighbor comparisons, while a single similarity score does not capture all semantic relationships.
references.applied: The bundled vectors are normalized once for cosine ranking. The exact secret always receives rank one, including tied vectors. UI copy explains meaning rather than spelling without presenting rank as a probability.

references.observed: Information should not depend on color alone; larger text, legible contrast and meaningful VoiceOver descriptions are required.
references.applied: Numerical ranks and verbal proximity bands accompany color. The dial has a complete VoiceOver summary, controls use at least 44-point targets, larger text stacks input/actions, and reduced motion removes rank animation.

validation.small_wall_adaptation: Short proximity labels and omitted RANK microcaption preserve the dial and keep the 64-pixel display readable; long guess labels scroll within a mask.
